title: Underived tensor comparison for pullback of modules on ringed topoi
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites small relative to the universe of the module sheaves, with sheaves of commutative rings $R,S$, and let $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi, an adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits, equipped with a ring map $c:u^{-1}R\to S$. On module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] put $u^*M=S\otimes_{u^{-1}R}u^{-1}M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For $R$-module sheaves $M,N$ there is a canonical $S$-linear isomorphism $u^*(M\otimes_RN)\xrightarrow{\sim}u^*M\otimes_Su^*N$, natural simultaneously in $M,N$.
